concept_uz: Zebra toychogʻi onasidan soʻraydi: «Chiziqlarimizni kim chizgan?» Javob — hech kim. Alan Tyuring 1952-yilda koʻrsatgan: ikki modda — sekin «yoquvchi» va tez «oʻchiruvchi» — naqshni oʻz-oʻzidan tugʻdiradi. Oxirida tomoshabinga savol: yoʻl-yoʻl hayvonning dumi dogʻli boʻla oladimi?

facts.claim: Embrion paytida hayvon terisida hech qanday chizma yoʻq
Alan Tyuring — kompyuter gʻoyasining otasi; 1952-yilda tirik mavjudotlarda shakl hosil boʻlishi haqida maqola chop etgan
Yoquvchi teri rangini qoraytiradi va oʻzidan koʻproq hosil qiladi; oʻchiruvchi uni toʻxtatadi va tezroq, uzoqroqqa tarqaladi
Natijada qora dogʻ atrofida oq hoshiya chiqadi, keyingi dogʻ hoshiyadan narida tugʻiladi — naqsh oʻz-oʻzidan paydo boʻladi
Jeyms Myurrey: ingichka dumda dogʻga joy yetmaydi, faqat koʻndalang halqalar chiqadi; dogʻli hayvonning dumi yoʻl-yoʻl boʻlishi mumkin (gepard), yoʻl-yoʻl hayvonning dumi dogʻli boʻlmaydi
Tyuring 1954-yilda vafot etgan; mexanizm keyin baliq terisida kuzatilgan

style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden African savanna light, soft painterly textures, rich saturated colours, expressive cartoon animals, gentle wonder-filled mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a golden savanna at sunrise: tall dry grass, one flat-topped acacia tree, a small still rainwater puddle in the foreground that reflects the sky like a mirror, soft mist on the horizon. No animals, no people.

Add a mother zebra and her small zebra foal standing by the puddle, 9:16. The mother is calm and graceful with long eyelashes. The foal is tiny and wobbly with big shiny eyes and a funny FLUFFY TUFT of mane sticking straight up on its head; its stripes are soft brown-and-white. The foal is bending over the puddle, staring at its own striped reflection.

Vertical 9:16 medium shot, respectful 3D animated reconstruction of a British mathematician of the early 1950s, about 40, dark wavy hair, thoughtful kind eyes, tweed jacket with a BROWN KNITTED TIE, sitting at a cluttered wooden desk by a rainy window at night, a desk lamp glowing, sheets of paper covered in hand-drawn spots and wavy lines (no readable writing), a pencil in his hand, a pinecone and a daisy on the desk.

Vertical 9:16 shot inside a glowing microscopic world: a smooth pale cream landscape of soft round cells like tiny pebbles. Two cute cartoon characters stand on it: QORACHI, a round, heavy, slow dark-charcoal ink blob with sleepy half-closed eyes and a big lazy smile; OQCHI, a small, fast, glowing white spark-sprite with tiny wings and a long light trail behind it, grinning mischievously. Soft magical light.

Change the moment, same microscopic cream landscape, 9:16, top-down camera: in the centre one round dark spot has appeared where Qorachi sits, and around it a clear bright white ring where Oqchi is racing in a circle, leaving a glowing trail. The rest of the landscape is still blank cream.

Change the moment, same top-down view, 9:16: the whole cream landscape is now covered with an even, beautiful pattern of dark spots and wavy dark stripes, each separated by a white gap; tiny Qorachi and Oqchi sit in the middle, proudly looking at their work.

Change the scene to the acacia tree in close-up, 9:16: a sleek cheetah lies on a thick branch, its body covered in round dark spots, while its long thin tail hangs down towards the camera clearly showing dark RINGS (stripes) near its tip. Golden sunrise light.

Change the moment: the zebra foal with the fluffy tuft has turned around and is looking back over its shoulder at its own thin striped tail with a puzzled, thinking face, the mother zebra smiling behind it, same puddle and light, 9:16.

lines.text: Hech kim, bolam. Ular oʻzi paydo boʻlgan.

scenes.prompt: The zebra foal stares at its reflection, splashes the puddle with a hoof, then looks up at its mother. Audio: a splash, crickets, savanna birds. The foal says in Uzbek with a bright, curious voice of a small child: "Oyi, chiziqlarimizni kim chizgan?" The mother zebra says in Uzbek with a soft, warm, calm voice of a gentle mother: "Hech kim, bolam. Ular o'zi paydo bo'lgan." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Toychoq hali ona qornida boʻlganida, terisida birorta ham chiziq yoʻq edi. Naqsh qayerdan keladi?

scenes.prompt: The foal tilts its head, unbelieving; the camera slowly circles the mother and foal as the sun rises behind the acacia. Audio: soft wind in the grass, a gentle music sting. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Toychoq hali ona qornida bo'lganida, terisida birorta ham chiziq yo'q edi. Naqsh qayerdan keladi?" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Kompyuter gʻoyasining otasi Alan Tyuring 1952-yilda bu savolga javob topdi: ikkita modda kifoya.

scenes.prompt: Slow push-in on the mathematician at his desk; he draws a dark spot with a white ring around it on paper, stops, and smiles as if he has just understood something. Audio: rain on the window, pencil scratching, a ticking clock. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Kompyuter g'oyasining otasi Alan Tyuring 1952-yilda bu savolga javob topdi: ikkita modda kifoya." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Men yoquvchiman. Qayerda boʻlsam, teri qorayadi.
Men oʻchiruvchiman. Va men tezroq yuguraman!

scenes.prompt: Qorachi the slow dark blob yawns and waves lazily; Oqchi the white spark zooms around him twice in a flash and stops, grinning. Audio: a deep bloop, then a fast whoosh. Qorachi says in Uzbek with a deep, slow, sleepy, good-natured cartoon voice: "Men yoquvchiman. Qayerda bo'lsam, teri qorayadi." Oqchi says in Uzbek with a quick, squeaky, excited cartoon voice: "Men o'chiruvchiman. Va men tezroq yuguraman!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Yoquvchi bir joyda koʻpaydi — dogʻ qoraydi. Oʻchiruvchi esa tezroq qochib, atrofini oqlab qoʻyadi.

scenes.prompt: Top-down: the dark spot in the centre grows slowly and pulses, while the white spark races around it faster and faster, keeping a clean white ring around the spot. Audio: a low hum for the dark spot, a high whoosh for the spark. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Yoquvchi bir joyda ko'paydi — dog' qoraydi. O'chiruvchi esa tezroq qochib, atrofini oqlab qo'yadi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Keyingi dogʻ faqat oq hoshiyadan narida tugʻiladi. Hech kim chizmagan naqsh — oʻz-oʻzidan.

scenes.prompt: Time-lapse from top-down: new dark spots pop up one after another just beyond each white ring, some stretch and join into wavy stripes, until the whole landscape is an even pattern. Audio: soft popping sounds building into a warm musical swell. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Keyingi dog' faqat oq hoshiyadan narida tug'iladi. Hech kim chizmagan naqsh — o'z-o'zidan." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Matematik Jeyms Myurrey sezdi: ingichka dumda dogʻga joy yetmaydi, u yerda faqat halqalar chiqadi.

scenes.prompt: Slow tilt down from the spotted cheetah body to its thin ringed tail swinging lazily below the branch; the cheetah yawns. Audio: a lazy purr, savanna birds. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Matematik Jeyms Myurrey sezdi: ingichka dumda dog'ga joy yetmaydi, u yerda faqat halqalar chiqadi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Unda mening dumim dogʻli boʻla oladimi?
Siz nima deysiz? Javobni izohda yozing!

scenes.prompt: The foal looks at its own striped tail, swishes it, then turns to the camera with a puzzled face and freezes mid-thought. Hold on the frozen frame. Audio: a swish, then silence and one soft bell. The foal says in Uzbek with a bright, curious voice of a small child: "Unda mening dumim dog'li bo'la oladimi?"
